status: provisional integration sizing; not an approved BOM
user_direction: Reuse the Beckhoff PLC and the flange-side connection already in the project scope; SC-facing interface remains OPC UA.

inputs.count_source: Latest user correction, 2026-10-14: eight channels, 8 V and 8 T; working sizing inventory

EL1859.role: one box-enable output; optional incoming enable/disable input

two_eight_channel_boxes.condition: Both box enables, and optional incoming enables, use one shared EL1859 in a common I/O bank.

excluded: PLC CPU and existing OPC UA/platform implementation
EtherCAT coupler/end terminal and power-feed infrastructure
PoF signal conditioning, connectors and wiring
proof of free DIN space, E-bus power and existing spare channels

rack_cells.meaning: May 2025 plan corroborates eight drivers/crate and mentions EL3202 flange RTD modules; current channel count comes from user correction.

infrastructure.meaning: Planning diagrams show Beckhoff PLC, EtherCAT remote I/O and flange interfaces; not proof of commissioning or spare capacity

slides.1: Reports 4–7 laser-PS voltage readings at about 3.3 V and one chassis RTD; OPC UA tested with UaExpert and FreeOpcUa; updates about 1 Hz.
slides.2: Burndy connector, cable and terminal-block assembly are work in progress.
slides.3: Two eight-channel chassis, each using an eight-pin Burndy connector and a terminal block to Opta I/O; no box-enable path or pin allocation shown.

source_presentation.interpretation: Connector/terminal-block reuse with Beckhoff is an integration proposal pending electrical/pinout mapping. Opta OPC UA client tests do not qualify Beckhoff wiring compatibility.
source_presentation.inventory_discrepancy: Source scope of 4–7 voltages + one RTD differs from user 8 V + 8 T working sizing; preserve the latter as an explicitly labelled working case.

control_scope.count_source: User correction: one enable per box; per-channel setpoints and feedback were unsupported sizing assumptions and have been removed.
control_scope.electrical_interface: Unverified; 24 V digital assumed for the example terminal.
control_scope.optional_incoming_enable: One incoming hardwired enable/disable signal fits a spare input on the same mixed terminal; its source, polarity and response remain to be defined.

rack_deployment.basis: May 2025 FD2 rack draft; requested draft numbers, not installed inventory
rack_deployment.working_case_source: User working inventory: 8 temperatures + 8 voltages + one normal enable per box. Not the signal inventory in the PoF team presentation.
rack_deployment.bank_arrangement: One common I/O bank per rack; the two boxes share one EL1859. Separate box banks need six terminals per rack, 240 overall.
rack_deployment.source_discrepancy: July 2026 meeting notes mention 42 PoF racks versus 40 in drawing. This slide deliberately uses the user-requested May draft of 40.
